args.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: NEW standalone airborne motorcycle and rider illustration on genuinely transparent background for KavirSavar's loading splash. Preserve this identity and motorcycle colors/details. Redraw them from a substantially DIFFERENT ANGLE: dramatic low front-left three-quarter view looking slightly upward at the jumping bike, front tire prominently foreshortened near upper/right, rear tire trailing lower/left, visible engine underside, motorcycle nose raised roughly 25 degrees, rider elbows bent and knees gripping the bike, energetic airborne launch pose. Premium richly painted stylized 3D-volume mobile racing illustration matching the first reference, expressive sculpted anatomy, crisp detailed engine cooling fins, spokes, silver exhaust, black knobby rubber. ONE rider and ONE motorcycle, no scarf, no environment, no ground, no text/logo/UI, no rectangle, no giant light flare. Landscape 3:2 cutout.
